These are the checks the house plugin adds to `pnpm check`. The pre-commit hook runs `pnpm check` before each commit. The list comes from the rules table in [`packages/rules/README.md`](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/README.md#rules-and-checks). The docs link in each row opens that rule's docs on GitHub.

| Rule | Tool | What it refuses | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="comment-discipline"></span>[`comment-discipline`](#comment-discipline) | ESLint | Keep comments local, short, and limited to necessary rationale. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/comment-discipline.md) |
| <span id="command-kind"></span>[`command-kind`](#command-kind) | ESLint | Require command features with literal flags; author queries with defineReadModel. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/command-kind.md) |
| <span id="no-broken-relative-links"></span>[`no-broken-relative-links`](#no-broken-relative-links) | ESLint | Require relative Markdown links, images, and definitions to name existing tracked or non-ignored untracked files inside the repository. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/no-broken-relative-links.md) |
| <span id="design-no-raw-color"></span>[`design-no-raw-color`](#design-no-raw-color) | ESLint | Disallow raw colours in CSS declaration values outside the design-token files. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-no-raw-color.md) |
| <span id="design-no-raw-color-literal"></span>[`design-no-raw-color-literal`](#design-no-raw-color-literal) | ESLint | Disallow raw hex colours and colour functions inside JavaScript and TypeScript strings. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-no-raw-color-literal.md) |
| <span id="design-no-unknown-token"></span>[`design-no-unknown-token`](#design-no-unknown-token) | ESLint | Require every `var(--name)` to resolve to a custom property defined in a token file or in the same file. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-no-unknown-token.md) |
| <span id="design-scale-value"></span>[`design-scale-value`](#design-scale-value) | ESLint | Require values of chosen properties to come from a fixed scale or from a token variable. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-scale-value.md) |
| <span id="design-css-layers"></span>[`design-css-layers`](#design-css-layers) | ESLint | Require every style rule to sit inside an allowed `@layer`, keep a restricted layer to its files, and disallow !important. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-css-layers.md) |
| <span id="design-no-raw-element"></span>[`design-no-raw-element`](#design-no-raw-element) | ESLint | Disallow a raw JSX element, such as \<button\>, where the design system's component folder has a component for it. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/design-no-raw-element.md) |
| <span id="shadcn"></span>[`shadcn/*`](#shadcn) | ESLint | Restyling, palette colours, arbitrary values, inline styles, dynamic classes and unknown classes. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/shadcn.md) |
| <span id="feature-file"></span>[`feature-file`](#feature-file) | ESLint | Require one direct defineFeature or defineReadModel in its matching entry-point index, contract-only imports, `index.ts` and tests/ only, and Features/ReadModels registries. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/feature-file.md) |
| <span id="feature-builders"></span>[`feature-builders`](#feature-builders) | ESLint | Require direct named builders, matching entry-point kinds and folders, statically read-only read-model edges, inline exposures and resolved system starts. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/feature-builders.md) |
| <span id="esm-only-effect"></span>[`esm-only-effect`](#esm-only-effect) | ESLint | Require ESM loading in production app and Effect workspace-package src, including both kits; tests, rules and top-level tooling are excluded. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/esm-only-effect.md) |
| <span id="no-hand-rolled-surface"></span>[`no-hand-rolled-surface`](#no-hand-rolled-surface) | ESLint | Forbid building MCP tools, RPCs, and HTTP API endpoints by hand outside the application package; build them from a contract. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/no-hand-rolled-surface.md) |
| <span id="no-hand-run-effect"></span>[`no-hand-run-effect`](#no-hand-run-effect) | ESLint | Forbid running an Effect by hand in a test: no `Effect.run*` and no `ManagedRuntime.make`. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/no-hand-run-effect.md) |
| <span id="no-computed-import"></span>[`no-computed-import`](#no-computed-import) | ESLint | Forbid an `import()` or `require()` whose specifier is computed in production package or app source, so every import stays visible to the graph checks, contract-entry-is-browser-safe among them. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/no-computed-import.md) |
| <span id="testing-exports-only-in-tests"></span>[`testing-exports-only-in-tests`](#testing-exports-only-in-tests) | ESLint | Forbid using a package's testing export, a name that ends in Testing, outside test files and outside testing code whose runtime exports are all named Testing. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/testing-exports-only-in-tests.md) |
| <span id="no-cycles"></span>[`no-cycles`](#no-cycles) | Dependency Cruiser | Circular file imports. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="packages-do-not-import-apps"></span>[`packages-do-not-import-apps`](#packages-do-not-import-apps) | Dependency Cruiser | Packages importing apps. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="apps-do-not-import-other-apps"></span>[`apps-do-not-import-other-apps`](#apps-do-not-import-other-apps) | Dependency Cruiser | Cross-app imports. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="packages-imported-by-name"></span>[`packages-imported-by-name`](#packages-imported-by-name) | Dependency Cruiser | Relative cross-package imports. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="packages-public-entry-only"></span>[`packages-public-entry-only`](#packages-public-entry-only) | Dependency Cruiser | Deep package imports. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="contract-entry-is-browser-safe"></span>[`contract-entry-is-browser-safe`](#contract-entry-is-browser-safe) | Dependency Cruiser | Package/projection contracts, feature/read-model indexes and registries, and way endpoints.ts reaching server code, storage, facades, adapters or untrusted installed code; invalid package export manifests. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md#contract-entry) |
| <span id="domain-imports-no-house-rules"></span>[`domain-imports-no-house-rules`](#domain-imports-no-house-rules) | Dependency Cruiser | Framework domain importing any other house-rules package, including type-only application/contract. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="application-does-not-import-event-log"></span>[`application-does-not-import-event-log`](#application-does-not-import-event-log) | Dependency Cruiser | Application kit importing event-log, including type-only imports; event delivery uses the kit-owned EventSource port. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="features-do-not-import-outer-folders"></span>[`features-do-not-import-outer-folders`](#features-do-not-import-outer-folders) | Dependency Cruiser | Features reaching ways or composition. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="read-models-import-packages-only"></span>[`read-models-import-packages-only`](#read-models-import-packages-only) | Dependency Cruiser | Queries importing app files outside their own folder except projection contracts, and projections importing other app folders. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="ways-in-import-app-folders-only"></span>[`ways-in-import-app-folders-only`](#ways-in-import-app-folders-only) | Dependency Cruiser | Ways importing root entries or other app files, including outside src, as bridges around folder fences. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="ways-in-do-not-import-read-model-values"></span>[`ways-in-do-not-import-read-model-values`](#ways-in-do-not-import-read-model-values) | Dependency Cruiser | Ways importing projection or private read-model values rather than exposed query indexes/registry. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md) |
| <span id="ways-in-import-contracts-only"></span>[`ways-in-import-contracts-only`](#ways-in-import-contracts-only) | Dependency Cruiser | Production ways, including barrels, importing values outside kits, effect, package contracts, own-way files, features or composition; any import, type-only included, of effect/sql, effect/sql/*, effect/unstable/sql or adapterImports; page/** and Next convention/private-folder files also permit third-party npm packages, never workspace mains or adapters. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md#ways-value-imports) |

| <span id="no-ownerless-files"></span>[`no-ownerless-files`](#no-ownerless-files) | Dependency Cruiser | utils/helpers/misc anywhere; caseless mechanism names in packages and read models. | [docs](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md#package-layout) |
